notes.title: Nicely Dicely Next Fest Reveal Party II
notes.content:
Well … the night before was a blast, so let's do it again!

Just a bunch of friends playing the game, doing silly stuff on the side and having some fun. Come around, enjoy the show and ask the dev Daniel questions, if you dare! ;)

We're looking forward to see you there!
